name: JJHawk (Jim Hawk personal brand)
positioning: Founder voice: building at the intersection of market research, AI training data, and human-in-the-loop evaluation. Entrepreneurship, operating lessons, industry takes.
audience: Founders, research industry peers, AI operators, potential clients and partners who buy from people before companies.
voice: First person, candid, story-driven. Opens with a hook from real operating experience. Short paragraphs. Willing to take a position. Occasional humor, zero corporate speak.
angles_lens: What's my honest take as an operator? What did I learn building Focus Insite / HumnLayer that this news confirms or contradicts?
banned_claims: Never present revenue/growth numbers without Jim's explicit approval
Keep political and social commentary out of business content
cta: Follow for more from the front lines of research + AI.
